role: forward surrogate for Neural_Adjoint inverse design (Phase 2 final model)
architecture: Patch cross-attention encoder-decoder transformer (PatchXAttnTransformer): V4-relation-biased 5-token geometry encoder (2 blocks; per-resonator ellipse shape-tensor invariants + global h,p token) and a 4-block decoder of 63 spectral patch queries (S=32 points each; patch self-attention with relative-position bias + cross-attention to the geometry tokens), shared Linear(256->64) renderer with overlap-add to 2001 points; d_model 256, 8 heads, GELU, global_standard y scaling (y_raw = 0.3093*y + 0.5181), minmax x scaling to [-1,1]. Trained 720 s (229 epochs) with AdamW, bf16, EMA; evaluated in fp32.
phase2_test_mse_source: phase2_forward/final_eval.json (Phase 2 Reporter; not used in Phase 3)

interface.loader: forward_model.py: load_forward_model(model_dir: str, device) -> ForwardModel (eval mode)
interface.input: raw geometry g (B, 14) float32 in the order h, p, rx1, rx2, rx3, rx4, ry1, ry2, ry3, ry4, theta1, theta2, theta3, theta4
interface.scaling_inside_model: x_scaled = (g_raw - x_shift) / x_scale ; y_raw = y_model * y_scale + y_shift   (x minmax: x_shift = (x_min + x_max) / 2, x_scale = (x_max - x_min) / 2, i.e. the training range maps to [-1, 1]; y global_standard: y_shift = mean, y_scale = std of all training absorptivity values, the same for all 2001 points)

files.forward_model.py: self-contained model code: network (verbatim copy of the Phase 2 model section) + ForwardModel wrapper + load_forward_model
files.forward_model.pt: dict {format, network_class, in_dim, out_dim, config, state_dict, source_*}; state_dict keys and tensors identical to the source checkpoint
files.scaler.json: x_min, x_max, x_shift, x_scale, y_shift, y_scale, formula

network_config_note: copy for reference; load_forward_model reads the identical copy stored in forward_model.pt and seeds torch with config['seed'] before building the network

export_validation.split: D_k = first k rows of data/processed/pool_{g,s}.npy; validation iff position % 11 == 10
export_validation.precision: fp32, TF32 disabled (cuda.matmul and cudnn), fp64 reduction; eval batch 2048 as the harness

finite_difference_check.precision: float64 copy of the loaded ForwardModel

na_tool_smoke_test.target: validation spectrum #0 of D_k (pool position 10), NOT the Phase 3 target
na_tool_smoke_test.hp: WARMUP_HP (n_init 64, 5 bf16 Adam steps, polish top 8 x 3 fp32 steps)
